Bash(gh pr create --title "Add multimodal vector database with ChromaDB and OpenCLIP" --body "$\(cat <<''EOF''
## Summary
- Add multimodal vector database using ChromaDB for persistent storage
- Use OpenCLIP \(ViT-B/32\) embeddings for text and image queries
- Support text-to-image and image-to-image similarity search

## Changes
- **New file:** `search-app/multimodal_vdb.py` - MultimodalVectorDB class
- **Updated:** `search-app/requirements.txt` - Added chromadb, open-clip-torch, Pillow
- **Updated:** `.gitignore` - Added .chromadb/ directory

## Features
- `query_by_text\(\)` - Search images using natural language
- `query_by_image\(\)` - Find similar images
- Persistent storage \(data loads once, persists across runs\)
- `force_reload` option to refresh data

## Test plan
- [ ] Run `python search-app/multimodal_vdb.py` to verify queries work
- [ ] Run script twice to verify data persistence \(should skip loading on second run\)
EOF
\)")
